variants.text: face shape: oval; bone structure: balanced; hairline: M-shaped with moderate temporal recession; brow ridge: moderately prominent; eyebrows: soft-arched, moderate density and length; eyes: almond-shaped, double upper-lid creases; nose: straight dorsum, medium bridge, rounded tip; mouth: medium width, balanced lips, defined cupid's bow, short philtrum; ears: average size, moderate protrusion, rolled helices, free lobes; hair: short dark, styled upwards; facial hair: stubble on jawline and upper lip.

variants.text: Short dark hair styled upwards and stubble facial hair on the jawline and upper lip complement an M-shaped hairline with moderate temporal recession. This individual has an oval face shape, soft-arched eyebrows of moderate density, and almond-shaped eyes with double upper-lid creases. The nose has a straight dorsum and rounded tip, while the mouth features a defined cupid's bow and short philtrum. The ears are of average size with rolled helices and free lobes.
